budget_is_not_reason_to_stop: Remaining allowance is ample. Stop is result-based, not exhaustion or a short Native window.

evidence_levels.expression_and_proof: Integer count cover, nested conditional numerator chords and count-scoped floor transport are valid. Standard scalar disjunction/R120 injection tools are not claimed as new general theory.
evidence_levels.relaxation: Conditional count covers improve all three diagnostic parent and matched Gini-midpoint covers. Two actual D0 optima are separated by the written fractional-b D1 projection; no optimized D1-over-D0 root LP gain occurs.
evidence_levels.complete_search: K20 D1 is materially faster than same-PE D0 with identical initial integer matrices except floor. K35 D1 improves U and slightly worsens L versus D0; much carrier repair is already present in D0. RB D1 materially regresses key complete endpoints. The coherent method has useful research signal without stable-default value.

rationale: K15/K20 retain two proofs, versus one for stable GI-TBC on these four roles; stock and TC/TC2 already had both proofs. D1 adds no proof over its carrier.
Relative to accepted stock, K15 and K20 proof-clock improvements are below the inherited max(10seconds,10% of smaller clock) materiality rule; K15 total is slightly slower.

K20 provides genuine conditional-floor attribution: D1 saves23.6894309 production seconds and24.7673724 total seconds versus D0, with matching root/probe data and all remaining initial integer-model coefficients.
K35 has a useful primal repair, but its lower bound falls versus stable GI-TBC; old TC+stock still improves both endpoints over D1. D0 versus D1 gives a real U/L tradeoff, not D0 dominance.

RB35-T2 D1 ends at U/L=.4137732750/.2279184194. It is worse on both endpoints than stock, TC2 and old TC+stock; versus stable GI-TBC its U is about20.1% worse despite a stronger L. This is an important full-cap role regression.

A favorable K20 and a K35 carrier repair do not outweigh the absence of material stock proof-time benefit plus the important RB regression. No run is censored and no cap is called a certification time.

The two proof floors are overtaken early in the carrier Native paths; this limits expected direct floor strength but is not a general redundancy theorem. Search outcomes cannot be explained solely by stronger root LP bounds or by the small probe cost.

conditional_work_decisions.reason: It would identify whether the RB loss arises from conditional delta or the common binary/links/cover combination. The unchanged D1 method already fails promotion; current paired controls do not favor D0 uniformly. This extra role is not needed if no causal RB-delta claim is made.
conditional_work_decisions.claim_boundary: Do not claim conditional delta caused RB regression, and do not claim RB D0 was tested or could never work.

conditional_work_decisions.reason: They could describe additional heterogeneity but cannot erase the completed important-role regression or establish robustness of this frozen candidate. Expansion would be mechanical without a new structural signal.

There is no close adoption ambiguity requiring seed confirmation. A favorable new seed would not undo adverse Seed0 evidence; an unfavorable one would not change the stop decision. No favorable-seed search.

D0 is materially slower on K20 and has worse K35 U for a small L advantage. There is no observed coherent D0 superiority to justify substituting it and opening a second full panel based on an unobserved RB outcome.

It would be a changed mechanism, not a correction to the tested valid floors. Current failures are complete-search outcomes rather than proof construction overhead or an identified invalid source. No additional LP is required to decide the current candidate; any future variant should first show source information that remains useful beyond Native early bounds.
